messages:
sam-sales: Quick handoff for Prospectum — closing trial next week, wanted to surface blockers and owners so CS/support/eng can take over. TL;DR: SSO not completing for pilot users, data ingestion lag, customer reported latency on embeddings (~2s spikes). Renewal/expansion conversation on Mon (4/8).

sam-sales: Context — 250k monthly tokens expected if they convert. They want Dedicated (VPC) but need +2 connectors (Okta SAML, S3 ingestion). Sales secured PO contingent on SSO working and a 1-week performance bake.

sam-sales: Current status: trial org created, 4 pilot users added, sample dataset uploaded (S3 link: https://s3.company/prospectum/sample). They hit SSO error on login flow: "Assertion consumer URL mismatch".

maria-cs: Thanks Sam — I can pick this up. I'll schedule kickoff + get access to the SAML metadata. @sam-sales can you drop the Okta org ID and the test user creds in 1Password? :lock:

sam-sales: Done — creds in 1Password (Prospectum/SSO-test). Okta org ID: prospectum-okta-42. Also dropped logs in the thread (excerpt):
```
2024-06-05T14:03:12Z ERROR saml: SP: invalid ACS url
2024-06-05T14:03:12Z DEBUG saml: RelayState=abc123 user=pilot1@prospectum.com
```

maria-cs: Good — initial look suggests ACS mismatch on our side or customer side config. I'll try re-running the metadata and confirm. Plan: 1) validate SAML metadata 2) repro with pilot user 3) open eng ticket if it's our connector.

jordan-eng: Looping in eng — I can triage the SSO connector if you can repro and share the SAML request/response. If it's ACS mismatch we usually fix by updating allowed ACS list (config). ETA for triage: today EOD. If it needs code change, estimate 2 business days.

devon-support: Filed ticket INF-3241 for the SSO error (assigned to jordan-eng). Captured steps to reproduce + link to raw SAML response (secure). Added severity=P1 since this blocks conversion.

maria-cs: Also flagging data ingestion latency: customer uploaded ~1.2M tokens and reported spikes in embedding generation. Is there a batching config we should tweak on their Dedicated preview? Or are they on Hosted?

sam-sales: They're on Hosted trial but wanting Dedicated. For now they tested on Hosted with ~2x token spikes during parallel uploads. They'd like recommended batching/throughput settings for Dedicated.

jordan-eng: For hosted spikes — likely due to small batch sizes and concurrent warmup. Quick wins: enable prefix KV caching for repeated contexts, configure batching window to 50ms and max batch size 64 for their workload. I'll draft config snippet: 
```
batching:
  window_ms: 50
  max_batch: 64
cache:
  prefix_kv: true
```
If they move to Dedicated, we'll recommend a 2-GPU pool with autoscale to 4 during onboarding.

maria-cs: Great — I'll share those recommendations in the kickoff. Also capturing customer feedback: they said UI for onboarding was "confusing" and they'd like clearer logs when SSO fails. Adding to product feedback backlog.

sam-sales: Renewal/expansion note: Sales asked for a readiness note before Mon's exec call. Can CS confirm go/no-go by EOD Mon? If SSO fixed + ingest perf acceptable, we proceed.

maria-cs: Agree. I'll run the verification steps and report by 17:00 Mon. If eng needs to expedite, mark INF-3241 as escalated.

jordan-eng: If INF-3241 requires a code change, ping me and I'll prioritize. Also @devon-support can you attach perf traces and token rate graphs to the ticket? That will speed the triage.

devon-support: Adding traces/graphs now. Ticket updated with links and the sample payload.

maria-cs: Next steps (owners):
- maria-cs: kickoff + SAML metadata validation + confirm with pilot users (owner)
- jordan-eng: triage INF-3241 + config or code fix (owner)
- devon-support: attach traces, monitor ticket, run post-fix smoke tests (owner)
- sam-sales: coordinate exec call + hold PO until CS sign-off (owner)

maria-cs: Action ask for eng/support: please confirm ETA and whether a config change will suffice or code change needed.

onboard-bot: Reminder — "Kickoff meeting: Prospectum onboarding" scheduled 2024-06-08 10:00 UTC.

jordan-eng: Confirmed triage started. Will update INF-3241 with preliminary root cause by 15:30 UTC.

sam-sales: Thank you all — I'll be on the exec call Monday and will share CS's readiness note. :pray:
